title: Battery range drop
symptoms: range lower than usual battery drains quickly after normal ride
summary: Record recent range, charge level, riding conditions and software version. Battery team reviews repeated range loss.
customer_guidance: We will review the recent range and charging information with the battery team.

title: Battery temperature warning
symptoms: battery temperature warning hot battery overheating thermal warning
summary: Stop using the vehicle and escalate to battery specialists. Do not suggest a repair procedure.
customer_guidance: Please stop using the vehicle and keep clear of any heat or smoke. A specialist will review this urgently.

title: Charging session will not start
symptoms: charger connected but charging will not start charging failed socket plug
summary: Record charger type, charge level and error code. Charging team checks the charging session.
customer_guidance: We will review the charging details and ask our charging team to investigate.

title: Charging interrupted
symptoms: charging stops intermittently session interrupted unplugged overnight
summary: Record when interruption occurred and the charger type. Charging team checks session history.
customer_guidance: We will check the interrupted charging sessions with our charging team.

title: Reduced drive power
symptoms: weak acceleration power reduced limp mode slow motor
summary: Record the warning and conditions. Drivetrain team reviews persistent reduced power.
customer_guidance: We will prioritize a drivetrain review of the reduced power report.

title: Motor noise
symptoms: unusual motor noise whine vibration while riding
summary: Record when the sound occurs. Drivetrain team checks the reported noise.
customer_guidance: We will arrange a drivetrain review of the reported noise.

title: Brake response concern
symptoms: brake failure brakes weak brake lever unresponsive cannot stop
summary: Stop using the vehicle and escalate immediately to braking specialists. Do not advise riding to a workshop.
customer_guidance: Please do not ride the vehicle. We will escalate the brake concern for urgent review.

title: Brake noise
summary: Record when noise occurs. Braking team assesses the report; escalate if stopping performance is affected.
customer_guidance: We will ask the braking team to assess the reported noise.

title: App pairing failure
symptoms: phone app pairing bluetooth cannot connect to vehicle
summary: Record app version and device type. Connectivity team reviews pairing failures.
customer_guidance: We will review the app pairing issue with our connectivity team.

title: Dashboard offline
symptoms: dashboard offline navigation not updating network disconnected
summary: Record the time and software version. Connectivity team reviews intermittent connectivity.
customer_guidance: We will review the dashboard connection issue with our connectivity team.

title: Display issue
symptoms: screen blank display flickers dashboard black screen
summary: Record when the display issue occurs. General service reviews the display report.
customer_guidance: We will arrange a service review of the display issue.

title: Appointment question
summary: Route scheduling questions to general service. Do not invent appointment availability.
customer_guidance: Our service team will help with the appointment request.
